transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... my supervisor told me I had to come. I guess... I keep leaving my station at work. Or getting up during meetings when I'm supposed to be sitting down. He says it's a safety issue because I just... take off before I even think about it.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're supposed to be still?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like if I have to sit for a safety meeting or... one of those certification classes. My foot is always bouncing. Or I'm clicking a pen... picking at my sleeves. I guess I shift around a lot. People usually ask me to stop.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking through the consequences?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess... maybe? I don't really think about it like that. I just kind of... do things. I haven't really noticed.
Do you often have trouble paying attention to details or making careless mistakes?

Um... no, not really. I mean, when I'm actually at my station, I do the work fine. I don't really mess up the parts or anything. I just... I don't know. I haven't really noticed any problems with that.
Do you often talk more than others in social situations?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean, I talk a lot at work. Like... during shift handoffs. I'll just keep explaining things or... making jokes, I guess. Even when I can tell the next person just wants to start working. I just... kind of keep going.
Do you often have trouble completing tasks or projects?
Um... no, not really. I mean, my job is pretty repetitive, so... you just finish one thing and start the next. I don't really have big projects to do. So... I guess I get it done fine.
Were you more active or restless than your peers when you were a child?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like, even back in elementary school... I couldn't really stay in my seat. I got a lot of notes sent home. Just for... blurting stuff out, or talking over the teacher. Or just wandering around the room, I guess. So... yeah.
Do you often have strong mood swings?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... my mood is just... fine, I guess. I don't really notice anything like that.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're at home or doing things you enjoy?

Um... yeah. I guess. Like... at work, if I have to just stand still by the machine, or... if we have to sit through some training thing... I don't know. It just feels like... like this pressure building up inside me. And I just... I have to move. Like, I have to pace around, or stretch, or just... go do something else right then. So... yeah, I guess I do.
Have you had trouble sitting still or felt restless for as long as you can remember?
Um... yeah. Pretty much. I mean... I don't really remember a time when I wasn't like that. Just... always, I guess.
Do you also talk a lot with friends or family, not just at work?

Um... I guess. But mostly it's... it's at work. Like when we're doing shift handoffs. I just... I talk a lot. Way too much, probably. I'll just keep explaining things, or... or making jokes. Even when I can tell the other person just wants to start working. I just... I don't stop.
Do you often interrupt others when they're speaking?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I don't do it on purpose, but... I end up cutting in on people. Like, I'll just jump into coworkers' conversations on the floor. Or... if the lead is asking a question, I'll just answer it before they're even done talking. It makes everybody pretty irritated with me... so, yeah.
Did you have a lot of energy and run around a lot when you were a kid?

Um... yeah. Even back in... like, elementary school. I guess I was just... that kid. 

I couldn't really stay in my seat. I'd just end up wandering around the room a lot. And... I don't know, I'd talk over the teacher. They sent a lot of notes home about it... just for me blurting things out or... not staying put. So... yeah.
Do you feel like your restlessness or impulsive behaviors are causing problems for you in your daily life or relationships?

Um... yeah. I guess. Mostly at work. My supervisors... they've actually written me up. Just for... safety stuff. And production. It's... it's kind of putting my job at risk right now. And my certification plans. Plus... I don't know, coworkers just... they're less willing to partner with me during handoffs anymore. So... yeah. It causes problems.
Do you have more trouble with staying focused on tasks or with sitting still and being quiet?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess... probably the sitting still part. But... I don't really know how to compare them, honestly. I just... I don't really think about which one is worse.
Do you think your trouble with staying focused on tasks is as much of a problem for you as your restlessness?
Um... I don't really know. Like I said... I just don't really think about it like that. It's just... how it is, I guess. I'm not sure if one is worse.
Do you think you have more trouble with paying attention or with being too active and restless?
I... I don't know. You kind of just asked me that. I guess the restless part. But I really don't pay attention to which one is worse.
Did you have any of these problems with restlessness, fidgeting, or talking a lot when you were a teenager?

Um... yeah. Pretty much always. Like... even back in elementary school, I was that kid. The one who couldn't stay in my seat. I'd, um, talk over the teacher... get notes sent home because I kept blurting things out or just wandering around the room. So... yeah. Since forever, I guess.
Have you experienced these symptoms of restlessness and fidgeting consistently throughout your life, including as a teenager and into adulthood?
I mean... yeah. Like I just said. It never really stopped. Just... always been this way.
Do you feel like your restlessness and impulsive behaviors are affecting your relationships with family or friends outside of work?
Um... I don't really know. I guess my family is just... used to me by now. I don't really pay much attention to it, to be honest. We don't really talk about that kind of stuff.
